Exact implementable CSS layout, no impossible glass effects or glow.

Below cards a substantial source reader panel with tabs Source / Relations / Context. Breadcrumb CouponRules.cs, code using exact public double CalculateTotal(double subtotal) { return subtotal * (1 - DiscountPercent / 100); }, line numbers and restrained syntax color.

Visual palette almost black navy #0b111b, surfaces #111c2b / #162337, text #e3edf9, muted #8193ab, accents #4c8dff and subtle violet. Use clean Segoe UI-like typography, 8px spacing, 10px corner radius, compact line icons. No large decorative illustrations. One faithful buildable product UI image, not collage.
